name: Sonic 3 A.I.R.
author: MDashK & gl33ntwine & Rinnegatamante
description: Sonic 3 A.I.R. (Angel Island Revisited) is a fan-made remaster of the classic Sega game Sonic 3 & Knuckles. This project modernizes the original game by adding widescreen support, improved graphics and audio, and new gameplay features. It is designed to offer a superior playing experience on modern systems while requiring original game data to run.
